subject: Urgent: Checkout failures impacting revenue — confirmation and credit request
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@clearmart.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearmart.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout failures during 10:12-10:34 PDT — impact & request for credit

Hi Hannah,

We saw a significant spike of 503s and timeouts on our checkout calls to Redwood between ~10:12 and 10:34 PDT today (request IDs: 2b7f6c, 2b7f70, 2b7f9a). During that window our checkout success fell from ~99.6% to ~78% and we estimate roughly $28k in lost GMV due to abandoned carts.

Can you confirm whether this qualifies for SLA consideration and what data you need from us to evaluate credit eligibility? I attached a bundle with client-side traces and a couple of screenshots. We also need a timeline and a postmortem — this is on our executive radar.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Sr. Ops Manager, ClearMart
Sophie.Lane@clearmart.com

Attachments: clearmart_client_traces.zip, clearmart_screenshots.zip

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@clearmart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during 10:12-10:34 PDT — impact & request for credit

Hi Sophie — thanks for flagging and for the traces. I'm looping in Rishi (SRE) and Laura (your account lead).

Quick next steps from our side:
- Rishi: can you confirm whether our telemetry shows elevated 5xxs in us-west-2 during the window and whether there was an autoscaler or deployment event?
- Laura: I'll coordinate credit eligibility and legal/billing process; please advise what contract items we should reference.

Sophie — could you add one example full request/response pair (raw headers) if possible and an estimate of the exact revenue hit you want us to use for calculations? That speeds the review.

We will start an expedited evidence pull now and aim to share a preliminary scope within 4 business hours.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@clearmart.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearmart.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during 10:12-10:34 PDT — impact & request for credit

Thanks Hannah — attaching a short list of example request IDs (2b7f6c, 2b7f70) and one raw client log for 2b7f6c. The bundle also has timeseries from our payment provider showing retries. Please prioritize — our finance team is waiting on an interim credit to adjust merchant payouts.

Sophie

Attachments: clearmart_client_traces.zip

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Initial infra check — 2028-04-03 17:10Z window

I'm pulling traces now. Preliminary check against our metrics:
- Confirmed elevated 503 rate in us-west-2 starting ~2028-04-03T17:11:30Z and returning to baseline ~2028-04-03T17:36:40Z (matching customer window).
- Error class: upstream 503 from router pool, amplified by a short-lived connection storm during a background autoscaler activity.
- No global control-plane rollout noted; appears regional.

I'm attaching the internal service trace bundle (service-trace-20280403.gz). I'll add a short note on whether this meets SLA "availability" criteria after we reconcile rolling-window calculations vs configured SLO buckets.

— Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: service-trace-20280403.gz

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@clearmart.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during 10:12-10:34 PDT — impact & request for credit

Thanks all — Rishi's confirmation is helpful. Sophie, based on the internal trace we see a regional availability disruption aligned with your timestamps. Next items from Redwood:

1) Evidence package: we'll produce a consolidated log bundle and the SLO calculation summary (expected within 8 hours).
2) Credit evaluation: to calculate potential credit we need the revenue estimate you provided, plus contract reference (term in section 5.2). Laura, can you confirm the contract term to use?
3) Postmortem: SRE will prepare a preliminary RCA draft and share a timeline for the final postmortem (target: 3 business days).

We're going to place the invoice/merchant impact on hold pending this review if you want to expedite. If you can confirm the $28k number or provide accounting backup, that'll speed the formal credit calculation.

I'll send an interim note once the evidence package is ready. Apologies for the disruption and we'll prioritize the RCA.

— Hannah
Senior Manager, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: billing@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 02:10:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Checkout disruption — start credit evaluation (Deal: CRM-7421)

Forwarding the thread to billing/legal to begin formal credit assessment for ClearMart (Deal CRM-7421). Please use the attached evidence links and the HubSpot record.

Requested items for billing/legal:
- Confirm which contract clauses govern pro-rata credit for availability (section 5.2).
- Calculate preliminary credit using the customer's $28,000 estimate and Redwood's SLA formula; present a provisional number for executive approval.
- Confirm any documentation we should ask ClearMart to supply for audit (invoices, merchant settlement reports).

I've opened INF-9812 in Jira to track the SRE RCA and postmortem. Rishi, please add the final trace and RCA there when ready.

— Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9812, https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/7421/company/clearmart
